combo_label: The Human Body × Hot Air Balloons × The Moon Landings

entries.clue: Move lightly up and down, as a basket does in choppy air
Bitter green juice made to help break down fatty food.
Warm ticklish hollow where the upper limb meets the body.
First human to set foot on another world, in July 1969
Christmas 1968 photograph of the blue planet climbing above a grey horizon
Lander that set the first two men down on the Sea of Tranquillity in 1969
Tapering point above a village church, a landmark from the air
Its needle counts off the feet between you and the ground below
Bony part of the face that drops open in astonishment
Joint you rest on a table, or use to nudge.
